title: Christmas Movies
description: From Rudolph to Kevin McCallister, test your knowledge of the family holiday classics. Grab the cocoa and prove you’re more than a cotton-headed ninny muggins.

questions.q: In the first Home Alone, the McCallisters jet off and leave Kevin behind. Where’s the rest of the family headed?
questions.reveal: Paris! Meanwhile Kevin gets the whole house and a cheese pizza all to himself. (Miami is the sequel: Kevin boards the wrong plane to New York.)

questions.q: Buddy the Elf swears by four main food groups. Which of these is NOT one of them?
questions.reveal: The official four: candy, candy canes, candy corns and syrup. Gingerbread didn’t make the cut. Your dentist weeps.

questions.q: What does Ralphie want for Christmas more than anything in the known universe?
questions.reveal: The Red Ryder BB gun — and every grown-up in Indiana warns him he’ll shoot his eye out. Spoiler: the glasses take one for the team.

questions.q: The Grinch straps fake antlers on his loyal dog and makes him pull the sleigh. What’s the poor pup’s name?
questions.reveal: Max! One antler, one very heavy sleigh, zero complaints. Best boy in Whoville history.

questions.q: Hermey the misfit elf doesn’t want to make toys. What does he dream of becoming instead?
questions.reveal: A dentist! Which comes in handy when the Abominable Snow Monster needs a little… dental work. The special first aired on NBC in 1964.

questions.q: What brings Frosty the Snowman to life in the classic 1969 special?
questions.reveal: A magic hat tossed out by a lousy magician named Professor Hinkle. One “Happy Birthday!” later, Frosty’s up and walking.

questions.q: On the Polar Express, Santa offers the boy the first gift of Christmas. What does he pick?
questions.reveal: A silver sleigh bell — and only people who truly believe can hear it ring. He loses it through a hole in his pocket, then finds it under the tree.

questions.q: Jack Skellington is the beloved Pumpkin King of which spooky town?
questions.reveal: Halloween Town! Jack gets bored of scaring, stumbles into Christmas Town, and decides he can totally run Christmas. He cannot.

questions.q: What’s the name of the guardian angel sent to save George Bailey?
questions.reveal: Clarence! He shows George what Bedford Falls would be like without him — and finally earns the wings he’s been waiting for.

questions.q: In The Muppet Christmas Carol, which Muppet plays Scrooge’s underpaid clerk, Bob Cratchit?
questions.reveal: Kermit! And yes, Miss Piggy plays his wife, Mrs. Cratchit. Fozzie, meanwhile, shows up as “Fozziwig.” Wocka wocka.

questions.q: What name do Harry and Marv give themselves, thanks to their habit of leaving the water running?
questions.reveal: The Wet Bandits — Marv’s calling card is flooding every house they rob. Kevin turns their crime spree into a slapstick obstacle course.

questions.category: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
questions.q: Kevin checks himself into which famous New York hotel with his dad’s credit card?
questions.reveal: The Plaza! Tim Curry plays the suspicious concierge who just can’t figure out this “Mr. McCallister” situation.

refs.label: Film
refs.ref: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992)

questions.q: Which comedy legend plays Papa Elf, the North Pole elf who raises Buddy?
questions.reveal: Bob Newhart! The deadpan king plays Buddy’s adoptive elf dad, who finally breaks the news that Buddy is, in fact, a human.

questions.q: In the 1947 classic, Kris Kringle gets a job as the Santa at which real New York department store?
questions.reveal: Macy’s! The film opens at Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, and Edmund Gwenn won an Oscar for playing Kris. Some say he really was Santa.

questions.q: Tim Allen’s Scott Calvin becomes Santa after Santa falls off his roof. What legally seals the deal?
questions.reveal: He puts on the suit — that’s the fine print of “the Santa Clause.” Cue a sudden beard, a growing belly and a very confused ex-wife.

questions.category: The Year Without a Santa Claus
questions.q: Feuding brothers Heat Miser and Snow Miser are both the sons of which powerful figure?
questions.reveal: Mother Nature! Mrs. Claus pays her a visit to get the boys to stop bickering long enough to let it snow in Southtown.

refs.label: Film
refs.ref: The Year Without a Santa Claus (1974)

questions.q: Lucy recruits Charlie Brown to cure his holiday blues by doing what?
questions.reveal: Directing the Christmas pageant — which goes about as well as kicking a football Lucy is holding. The jazzy score is by the Vince Guaraldi Trio.

questions.q: In Netflix’s Klaus, spoiled postman Jesper is exiled to which grumpy frozen island town?
questions.reveal: Smeerensburg, where two families have feuded for centuries. Klaus earned an Oscar nomination for Best Animated Feature.

questions.q: Bing Crosby and Danny Kaye rescue their old general’s struggling inn. In what state is it?
questions.reveal: Vermont — which, awkwardly, has no snow when they arrive. The flakes finally fall during the big “White Christmas” finale.

questions.q: The song “White Christmas” debuted in Holiday Inn. Who co-stars with Bing Crosby in that film?
questions.reveal: Fred Astaire! And “White Christmas” won the Oscar for Best Original Song — 12 years before it got its own movie.

questions.q: Jim Carrey went green for the 2000 live-action Grinch. Who directed it?
questions.reveal: Ron Howard! The film won the Oscar for Best Makeup — Carrey spent hours in the chair getting Grinched every day.

questions.q: George Bailey’s hometown becomes “Pottersville” in his nightmare vision. What’s its real name?
questions.reveal: Bedford Falls! Without George, greedy Mr. Potter takes over and renames the place after himself. Rude.

questions.q: Which horror-movie legend narrates AND voices the Grinch in the 1966 animated special?
questions.reveal: Boris Karloff — Frankenstein’s monster himself! He didn’t sing “You’re a Mean One, Mr. Grinch,” though; that was Thurl Ravenscroft.

questions.q: Tim Burton’s name is on the poster, but who actually directed The Nightmare Before Christmas?
questions.reveal: Henry Selick! Burton came up with the story and produced. Danny Elfman wrote the songs and provided Jack’s singing voice.

questions.q: Ralphie finally decodes the Little Orphan Annie secret message. What does it say?
choices: Be sure to drink your Ovaltine
questions.reveal: “Be sure to drink your Ovaltine.” A crummy commercial! Ralphie learns about advertising the hard way.

questions.q: Which beloved entertainer, famous for his big nose, narrates the 1969 Frosty special?
questions.reveal: Jimmy “The Schnozz” Durante! Frosty himself is voiced by comedian Jackie Vernon.

questions.q: Which folk singer voices Sam the Snowman, the narrator of Rankin/Bass’s Rudolph?
questions.reveal: Burl Ives! Sam also sings “A Holly Jolly Christmas” and “Silver and Gold” in the special.

questions.q: Which future movie star played little Susan Walker, the girl who doesn’t believe in Santa, in 1947?
questions.reveal: Natalie Wood, still just a kid! She’d later earn three Oscar nominations — but first she had to learn to believe.

questions.q: Clarence hasn’t earned his wings yet. What’s his official rank in heaven?
questions.reveal: Angel Second Class — “AS2” for short. He’s waited about 200 years to earn his wings. And remember: every time a bell rings, an angel gets his wings!

questions.q: Which actor voices Arthur, Santa’s clumsy, Christmas-crazy younger son, in Aardman’s Arthur Christmas?
questions.reveal: James McAvoy! Hugh Laurie voices his big brother Steve, Jim Broadbent plays Santa and Bill Nighy steals scenes as Grandsanta.
